summary: Elevate your records management skills with our SharePoint and Office 365 course. Gain practical knowledge to implement digital solutions effectively.
lede: Digital records management implementation with SharePoint and Office 365 creates a practical foundation for dependable retrieval, controlled access, retention discipline, audit evidence, and lasting governance. It replaces disconnected folders with a coordinated information governance and records lifecycle system. The course shows practitioners how to translate requirements into SharePoint architecture, configure Microsoft Purview capabilities, develop file plans and metadata, and apply retention and disposition controls. It also covers permissions, sharing protocols, migrations, user adoption, approvals, version control, and governance documentation.
audienceIntro: This course is specifically crafted for professionals responsible for modernizing records systems and ensuring compliant document control.
audience: Compliance, risk, internal audit, and governance teams
Procurement, legal, and contract management staff
Quality management and ISO implementation teams
Data protection and information security teams
modules: Foundations of Digital Records Management in Microsoft 365
Governance and Operating Model for SharePoint Records
Information Architecture and File Plan Design
SharePoint Site Design for Records Control
Migration from Shared Drives and Legacy Systems
Audit Readiness, Compliance Reporting, and Donor Evidence Packs
User Adoption, Change Management, and Training Rollout
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, as well as experience in records management or related fields. Familiarity with organizational governance and compliance processes is beneficial.
